alert.name: DatabaseAlarm
alert.summary: Alert fired for PostgreSQL database warden

root_cause.hypothesis: Connection pool near cap (63/79, ~80%) but no idle-in-transaction, no long-running queries, no lock waits, no recent deploys. Points to organic conn growth (traffic/pool misconfig) not a code regression or query pathology. Alert likely threshold trip on normal load creep, or pool size (max_connections=79) set low for traffic.
evidence: idle_in_transaction=0, long_running_queries=0, locks_waiting=0 — rules out stuck txns/query pathology as driver
RECENT DEPLOYS empty — no deploy correlation
LOGS empty — no error signal to corroborate

proposal.reasoning: 63/79 conns (~80%) but no idle-in-transaction, no long-running queries, no lock waits, no deploys. No acute failure signature to remediate automatically. proposal.expected_effect: Human reviews pool sizing (max_connections) and traffic trend, decides whether to raise pool cap, add read replica, or tune app-side connection pooling. No immediate change to running system.
